verdict: Leg 3, re-armed and scoped to the bot-round fold be6db60e..a42db73c (mmnto-ai/totem#2879, Greptile P1 and P2): 0 BLOCKING, 3 MATERIAL, 5 MINOR. The code path converged on the fold's own terms: the producer key verified correct for the originating incident from the live API (the two D1 runs share app and workflow name across two check suites and two workflow runs); matrix jobs, two apps and two differently-named workflows closed and grounded; the null-shape read total by code and by schema; the three fixtures kill their mutants (JSON.parse rounds 9007199254740993 and isSafeInteger rejects the rounded value); the reshape machine-verified to have changed no verdict across all 71 fixtures; receipts recomputed. What did not converge was the boundary of the claim: r3-F1 the spec declared the residual closed while two of Greptile's named classes survived a key on the workflow's display NAME — two workflow files sharing a name, and two same-named jobs in one workflow run — and the API exposes the identity fields at the same depth (folded: the producer keys on the workflow's database id; two same-named runs of one producer that share a check suite fail closed; two fixtures); r3-F2 five stale clauses in the spec's ruled design and files-touched, one inverted (folded: the spec rewritten to the shipped design); r3-F3 the exported checks JSDoc and the changeset still defined total as names, the changeset contradicting itself (folded: checks, a name under one producer); r3-F4 the unsafe-id fixture's role and README row named 9007199254740993 while the file carries the rounded 9007199254740992 (folded: worded as written and rounded); r3-F5 the producer fell back on the workflow name not reading rather than on the app not being Actions, a fail-open direction (folded: an Actions run without a readable workflow id is a producer that did not read); r3-F6 the refined null-id arm was unpinned (folded: a two-producers-one-null-id fixture, both judged); r3-F7 the producer interpolated unquoted beside a quoted name (folded: JSON-quoted in the notice and the deny detail); r3-F8 the README's fourth-re-make sentence over-generalised the stamp and dropped the synthesizedAt guard (folded). The key change rewires semantics; a fourth scoped leg follows, then convergence.
